control_failures.control_label: authorisation of switching and access to apparatus

facts.site: Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility
facts.title: potential incident - electrical exposure at TX-3002

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was no injury or loss. The potential outcome was rated 1 against the site's consequence scale, above the 0 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control SWITCHING_AUTHORISATION: the authorisation of switching and access to apparatus had been bypassed, and the ICAM investigation classified this as a task or environmental condition.

recommendations: Confirm at the next critical control verification that the authorisation of switching and access to apparatus on TX-3002 performs as designed.
response.sequence: Work was under way in controlling access to energised apparatus, specifically switching, racking and access authorisation. TX-3002 (switchgear and transformers) is in service for plant HV/LV distribution. The task proceeded during commissioning of replacement equipment while the authorisation of switching and access to apparatus had been bypassed. The electrical energy involved is held as HV switchgear, and the recorded presentation was shock, arc flash, unplanned energisation.
response.summary: On 27 March 2016 a potential incident was recorded on TX-3002 at Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility during commissioning of replacement equipment; electrical energy held as HV switchgear was not released.
